evidence_snippet: fetch('/api/v1/frontend/menu', { credentials: 'include' }) inside kiosk SPA returns: status=200, content_type='text/html; charset=UTF-8', body='<!DOCTYPE html>...' (Laravel SPA catchall HTML). Route is auth:sanctum-protected; an unauthenticated kiosk session is silently served the SPA fallback instead of a 401 JSON. Matches the 'silent HTML masquerade' anti-pattern (cf. feedback_silent_html_masquerade.md).
suggested_fix: Force JSON response for /api/* routes when auth fails by adding `Accept: application/json` header gate in `app/Exceptions/Handler.php` rendering (return `response()->json(['message' => 'Unauthenticated'], 401)` when `$request->is('api/*')`). Verify Sanctum guard is enabled on this route + test from anonymous + machine-authenticated contexts.

evidence_snippet: Cart bar shows '€0,00' (currency symbol BEFORE amount). French locale convention is '0,00 €' (symbol AFTER amount, with non-breaking space). All price displays in catalog/sidebar follow same pattern: '€2,00' instead of '2,00 €'.
suggested_fix: Audit currency formatter in `resources/js/helpers/format-price.js` or `app/Services/Pricing/PricingService.php` for FR locale. PHP NumberFormatter::CURRENCY with fr_FR yields '2,00 €'. Confirm `App\Settings\CurrencySettings::symbol_position` is 'after' for FR branches. Frontend likely concatenates `${symbol}${amount}` regardless — needs locale-aware ordering.
